claims.text: Evaluated Large Language Models exhibit varied levels of bias across gender, race, and ethnicity dimensions when measured on Google BIG-Bench.
No single tested Large Language Model uniformly excels across all fairness and bias metrics.
Google BIG-Bench can be utilized to evaluate bias and fairness across ChatGPT-4, Google Gemini, and Llama 2.

evidence.description: Our analysis reveals varied levels of biases across models, with disparities particularly notable in dimensions such as gender, race, and ethnicity.
Comparative performance analysis indicates that while each model exhibits strengths in certain areas, no single model uniformly excels across all fairness and bias metrics.
This study performs a comprehensive evaluation of bias and fairness within Large Language Models (LLMs), including ChatGPT-4, Google Gemini, and Llama 2, utilizing the Google BIG-Bench benchmark.

methodologies.name: BIG-Bench Comparative Bias and Fairness Evaluation
methodologies.description: Comparative benchmarking of LLMs across gender, race, and ethnicity bias metrics using Google BIG-Bench.

limitations.text: The Google BIG-Bench benchmark faces challenges in capturing sophisticated manifestations of bias that emerge in real-world contexts.

future_work.text: Continued innovation in model training and benchmarking methodologies to enhance the fairness and inclusivity of future LLMs.
